get.description: Most recently active first; id breaks ties between equal timestamps.

post.description:
Stream the answer: `start`, then `delta` text pieces and `tool` notices, then `done`
(or `error`).

Uses run_stream_events (not run_stream): run_stream would end at the first text the model
writes, so a tool call after "Let me check…" would never run.

Queue a document for ingestion again (e.g. after a failure).

delete.description: Delete the document, its chunks (ON DELETE CASCADE) and the stored file.

post.description: Execute the proposal (e.g. actually save the note).
Discard the proposal; nothing is written.
